idea-plugin.name: Tolgee
idea-plugin.description:
Tolgee for JetBrains

Community-maintained by a Tolgee core contributor. Not (yet) part of the official Tolgee product family — support and bug reports go through the plugin's GitHub repository, not through Tolgee's channels. "Tolgee" is a trademark of Tolgee s.r.o.

Bring the Tolgee localization platform into your IDE. Push, pull, and autocomplete translation keys — with ICU parameter support — without leaving the editor.

Features

  • Tool window — link an IDE project to a Tolgee project, browse local translation files, push/pull whole projects or single files.
  • Code completion — translation keys autocomplete inside recognized call sites in JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX/TSX, Java, Kotlin, and Android strings.xml.
  • ICU parameters — when a key uses parameters (including plurals), the plugin inserts an argument shaped for the host language ({ name: name } in JS, params={{ name: name }} in the <T> component, mapOf("name" to name) in Kotlin, Map.of("name", name) in Java) and pre-selects the first placeholder so you can start typing immediately.
  • Local-first cache — completion reads from the on-disk translation files, so it stays fast and works offline. Push and Pull refresh the cache automatically.
  • Scoped push / pull — right-click a namespace directory or a single <lang>.json to sync just that scope, or use the toolbar to sync the whole project.

Getting started

  1. Open the Tolgee tool window on the right sidebar.
  2. Click +, paste your Tolgee instance URL and API key (a Project API Key tgpak_… or a Personal Access Token tgpat_…).
  3. Click Load projects, pick one, hit Add. The plugin pulls translations and warms the completion cache.
  4. Start typing a key name inside t('…') or <T keyName="…" /> — suggestions appear immediately.

Compatibility

Requires IntelliJ Platform 2025.1 or later. Works in IntelliJ IDEA (Ultimate and Community), WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, RustRover, RubyMine, PhpStorm, Android Studio, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs. Language-specific completion loads only if the corresponding language plugin is present — everything else works everywhere.

Source and support

github.com/bdshadow/tolgee-intellij-plugin — issues, source, contributions welcome.
